thread:
maria-ops: Quick update before today's all-hands at 11:00 — small logistics + recording notes. Please read.

gabe-av: Seeing one change: roadmap moved to slot A (first 20m). Need to confirm remote presenter flow (we have a guest on Zoom).

sasha-prod: Noted. Who's managing Zoom to OBS capture? NDI or screen-share? Zoom sometimes drops frames.

gabe-av: We'll use NDI when possible. If guest can't enable NDI, fallback to a dedicated capture box. Testing now.

remy: Marketing asked for a separate clean feed of the roadmap slides + host camera (no captions burned) for social clips. Any constraints on bitrate?

emily-marketing: Prefer 4K/6Mbps for the clip; we'll transcode down if needed. Also want a plain transcript SRT.

maria-ops: Approved. Gabe — please record an ISO roadmaps.mp4 at high bitrate and upload to marketing bucket after. Retention 90d for that clip.

gabe-av: Will run a parallel ffmpeg capture: `ffmpeg -i rtmp://local -c:v libx264 -b:v 6M -preset fast roadmaps_iso.mp4`

deploy-bot: automated: recording_job=checkpoint_rehearsal status=success duration=00:28:11 artifacts=/artifacts/checkpoint_rehearsal.mp4

gabe-av: Rehearsal note: guest's Zoom client dropped to 15fps when screen-share started. Suspect GPU/encoding conflict. If it happens live, we'll switch guest to audio-only and push slides from our machine.

sasha-prod: For Q&A — leadership wants live Slack questions first, then audience mics. We'll do Slack -> in-room -> live. Who's moderating Slack?

emily-marketing: I can triage Slack Qs and hand up to the MC. I'll pin a question-collection message now.

maria-ops: Great. Also: switch mic cue 3 to "open" 2 minutes before Q&A and mark it in the show notes. Gabe, patch in-room audio to the stream mix but keep a separate isolated track for podcast.

gabe-av: Patch done. Added isolated tracks: host.wav, guest.wav, room_mics.wav. Also set scene 'allhands-main' and 'allhands-roadmap'.

remy: Captions were lagging in rehearsal (~6s). Who owns captions infra? We need the ingest token bump before go-time.

sasha-prod: Infra owns rate limits. I put a request in #eng-infra for captions bump and alerted paging.

maria-ops: If captions aren't within 3s of live, disable live captions and enable post-event transcript generation. We'll still post the SRT.

gabe-av: Also lowering OBS canvas to 1280x720 for the live stream to reduce encoder load. High-bitrate ISO remains at 6M.

emily-marketing: One more ask: add a short 20s clip with intro overlay (logo + lower-third). Can we bake that into the ISO roadmap?

gabe-av: I'll record a short bumper and save as roadmaps_bumper.mp4, then concatenate post-event.

remy: Leadership prep: Heads up that product will get 4 questions about Dedicated SLAs and one on Private deploy timelines. CEO wants the SLA Q answered in the roadmap segment.

maria-ops: Forwarded the questions to CEO and Head of Product. They have a 2-slide backup with concise bullets.

deploy-bot: automated: scheduled_job=allhands_live start=2026-03-23T10:55:00Z owner=maria-ops state=scheduled

gabe-av: Final checklist I posted to #all-hands-ops: ```1) confirm NDI/capture 2) start local ISO recording 3) enable cloud-encoder fallback 4) verify captions token 5) set scene transitions 600ms 6) upload bumper to media folder```

sasha-prod: Can we shorten transitions to 400ms for slide speed? rehearsal showed 600ms was fine but audience prefers snappier cuts.

gabe-av: 400ms caused dropped frames on the capture box. Keep 600ms for safety.

emily-marketing: After event, I'll request edit access for the ISO file and generate social clips. Please tag me when uploaded.

maria-ops: Perfect. Everyone meet at 10:55 for a quick check. If anything goes wrong during the live, @here and call me on my cell.

deploy-bot: automated: job_reminder=allhands_live runs_in=15m participants=6"
